$Comment: Adds 450 to the Great Turkey's maximum health while its fight has at least 5 players in it: its fight's script applies it as the Great Turkey rises, one step per player up to 5, then refills it (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Scale_TopUp), since a higher maximum leaves its current health where it was. It stays on the Great Turkey for the whole fight. Amount is the health one more player adds; change the four steps together.
